grades.quote: This message-storage server listens on port 2718 for connections. Each time it gets one, it reads a line of text from the connection to use as a new message to store.
grades.reason: This is a figure caption for a server that listens on a port and handles a connection each time one arrives. It shows the listening role only loosely. It never mentions accept, a new socket, or why the two are separate.
Overview of how TCP segments, sequence numbers and retransmission work. It doesn't discuss the listening socket versus the connected socket returned by accept.
